verses.en: And Abraham was old, and well stricken in age: and the LORD had blessed Abraham in all things.
verses.pt: Ora, Abraão era já velho e de idade avançada; e em tudo o Senhor o havia abençoado.
verses.en_web: Abraham was old, and well stricken in age. Yahweh had blessed Abraham in all things.
verses.en_bbe: Now Abraham was old and far on in years: and the Lord had given him everything in full measure.

verses.en: And Abraham said unto his eldest servant of his house, that ruled over all that he had, Put, I pray thee, thy hand under my thigh:
verses.pt: E disse Abraão ao seu servo, o mais antigo da casa, que tinha o governo sobre tudo o que possuía: Põe a tua mão debaixo da minha coxa,
verses.en_web: Abraham said to his servant, the elder of his house, who ruled over all that he had, “Please put your hand under my thigh.
verses.en_bbe: And Abraham said to his chief servant, the manager of all his property, Come now, put your hand under my leg:

verses.en: And I will make thee swear by the LORD, the God of heaven, and the God of the earth, that thou shalt not take a wife unto my son of the daughters of the Canaanites, among whom I dwell:
verses.pt: para que eu te faça jurar pelo Senhor, Deus do céu e da terra, que não tomarás para meu filho mulher dentre as filhas dos cananeus, no meio dos quais eu habito;
verses.en_web: I will make you swear by Yahweh, the God of heaven and the God of the earth, that you shall not take a wife for my son of the daughters of the Canaanites, among whom I live.
verses.en_bbe: And take an oath by the Lord, the God of heaven and the God of the earth, that you will not get a wife for my son Isaac from the daughters of the Canaanites among whom I am living;

verses.en: But thou shalt go unto my country, and to my kindred, and take a wife unto my son Isaac.
verses.pt: mas que irás à minha terra e à minha parentela, e dali tomarás mulher para meu filho Isaque.
verses.en_web: But you shall go to my country, and to my relatives, and take a wife for my son Isaac.”
verses.en_bbe: But that you will go into my country and to my relations and get a wife there for my son Isaac.

verses.en: And the servant said unto him, Peradventure the woman will not be willing to follow me unto this land: must I needs bring thy son again unto the land from whence thou camest?
verses.pt: Perguntou-lhe o servo: Se porventura a mulher não quiser seguir-me a esta terra, farei, então, tornar teu filho à terra donde saíste?
verses.en_web: The servant said to him, “What if the woman isn’t willing to follow me to this land? Must I bring your son again to the land you came from?”
verses.en_bbe: And the servant said, If by chance the woman will not come with me into this land, am I to take your son back again to the land from which you came?

verses.en: And Abraham said unto him, Beware thou that thou bring not my son thither again.
verses.pt: Respondeu-lhe Abraão: Guarda-te de fazeres tornar para lá meu filho.
verses.en_web: Abraham said to him, “Beware that you don’t bring my son there again.
verses.en_bbe: And Abraham said, Take care that you do not let my son go back to that land.

verses.en: The LORD God of heaven, which took me from my father’s house, and from the land of my kindred, and which spake unto me, and that sware unto me, saying, Unto thy seed will I give this land; he shall send his angel before thee, and thou shalt take a wife unto my son from thence.
verses.pt: O Senhor, Deus do céu, que me tirou da casa de meu pai e da terra da minha parentela, e que me falou, e que me jurou, dizendo: Â tua o semente darei esta terra; ele enviará o seu anjo diante de si, para que tomes de lá mulher para meu filho.
verses.en_web: Yahweh, the God of heaven, who took me from my father’s house, and from the land of my birth, who spoke to me, and who swore to me, saying, ‘I will give this land to your offspring. He will send his angel before you, and you shall take a wife for my son from there.
verses.en_bbe: The Lord God of heaven, who took me from my father's house and from the land of my birth, and made an oath to me, saying, To your seed I will give this land: he will send his angel before you and give you a wife for my son in that land.

verses.en: And if the woman will not be willing to follow thee, then thou shalt be clear from this my oath: only bring not my son thither again.
verses.pt: Se a mulher, porém, não quiser seguir-te, serás livre deste meu juramento; somente não farás meu filho tornar para lá.
verses.en_web: If the woman isn’t willing to follow you, then you shall be clear from this oath to me. Only you shall not bring my son there again.”
verses.en_bbe: And if the woman will not come with you, then you are free from this oath; only do not take my son back there.

verses.en: And the servant put his hand under the thigh of Abraham his master, and sware to him concerning that matter.
verses.pt: Então pôs o servo a sua mão debaixo da coxa de Abraão seu senhor, e jurou-lhe sobre este negócio.
verses.en_web: The servant put his hand under the thigh of Abraham his master, and swore to him concerning this matter.
verses.en_bbe: And the servant put his hand under Abraham's leg, and gave him his oath about this thing.

verses.en: And the servant took ten camels of the camels of his master, and departed; for all the goods of his master were in his hand: and he arose, and went to Mesopotamia, unto the city of Nahor.
verses.pt: Tomou, pois, o servo dez dos camelos do seu senhor, porquanto todos os bens de seu senhor estavam em sua mão; e, partindo, foi para a Mesopotâmia, à cidade de Naor.
verses.en_web: The servant took ten camels, of his master’s camels, and departed, having a variety of good things of his master’s with him. He arose, and went to Mesopotamia, to the city of Nahor.
verses.en_bbe: And the servant took ten of his master's camels, and all sorts of good things of his master's, and went to Mesopotamia, to the town of Nahor.

verses.en: And he made his camels to kneel down without the city by a well of water at the time of the evening, even the time that women go out to draw water.
verses.pt: Fez ajoelhar os camelos fora da cidade, junto ao poço de água, pela tarde, à hora em que as mulheres saíam a tirar água.
verses.en_web: He made the camels kneel down outside the city by the well of water at the time of evening, the time that women go out to draw water.
verses.en_bbe: And he made the camels take their rest outside the town by the water-spring in the evening, at the time when the women came to get water.

verses.en: And he said, O LORD God of my master Abraham, I pray thee, send me good speed this day, and shew kindness unto my master Abraham.
verses.pt: E disse: Ó Senhor, Deus de meu senhor Abraão, dá-me hoje, peço-te, bom êxito, e usa de benevolência para com o meu senhor Abraão.
verses.en_web: He said, “Yahweh, the God of my master Abraham, please give me success today, and show kindness to my master Abraham.
verses.en_bbe: And he said, O Lord, the God of my master Abraham, let me do well in what I have undertaken this day, and give your mercy to my master Abraham.

verses.en: Behold, I stand here by the well of water; and the daughters of the men of the city come out to draw water:
verses.pt: Eis que eu estou em pé junto à fonte, e as filhas dos homens desta cidade vêm saindo para tirar água;
verses.en_web: Behold, I am standing by the spring of water. The daughters of the men of the city are coming out to draw water.
verses.en_bbe: See, I am waiting here by the water-spring; and the daughters of the town are coming out to get water:

verses.en: And let it come to pass, that the damsel to whom I shall say, Let down thy pitcher, I pray thee, that I may drink; and she shall say, Drink, and I will give thy camels drink also: let the same be she that thou hast appointed for thy servant Isaac; and thereby shall I know that thou hast shewed kindness unto my master.
verses.pt: faze, pois, que a donzela a quem eu disser: Abaixa o teu cântaro, peço-te, para que eu beba; e ela responder: Bebe, e também darei de beber aos teus camelos; seja aquela que designaste para o teu servo Isaque. Assim conhecerei que usaste de benevolência para com o meu senhor.
verses.en_web: Let it happen, that the young lady to whom I will say, ‘Please let down your pitcher, that I may drink,’ and she will say, ‘Drink, and I will also give your camels a drink,’—let her be the one you have appointed for your servant Isaac. By this I will know that you have shown kindness to my master.”
verses.en_bbe: Now, may the girl to whom I say, Let down your vessel and give me a drink, and who says in answer, Here is a drink for you and let me give water to your camels: may she be the one marked out by you for your servant Isaac: so may I be certain that you have been good to my master Abraham.

verses.en: And it came to pass, before he had done speaking, that, behold, Rebekah came out, who was born to Bethuel, son of Milcah, the wife of Nahor, Abraham’s brother, with her pitcher upon her shoulder.
verses.pt: Antes que ele acabasse de falar, eis que Rebeca, filha de Betuel, filho de Milca, mulher de Naor, irmão de Abraão, saía com o seu cântaro sobre o ombro.
verses.en_web: Before he had finished speaking, behold, Rebekah came out, who was born to Bethuel the son of Milcah, the wife of Nahor, Abraham’s brother, with her pitcher on her shoulder.
verses.en_bbe: And even before his words were ended, Rebekah, the daughter of Bethuel, the son of Milcah, who was the wife of Nahor, Abraham's brother, came out with her water-vessel on her arm.

verses.en: And the damsel was very fair to look upon, a virgin, neither had any man known her: and she went down to the well, and filled her pitcher, and came up.
verses.pt: A donzela era muito formosa à vista, virgem, a quem varão não havia conhecido; ela desceu à fonte, encheu o seu cântaro e subiu.
verses.en_web: The young lady was very beautiful to look at, a virgin. No man had known her. She went down to the spring, filled her pitcher, and came up.
verses.en_bbe: She was a very beautiful girl, a virgin, who had never been touched by a man: and she went down to the spring to get water in her vessel.

verses.en: And the servant ran to meet her, and said, Let me, I pray thee, drink a little water of thy pitcher.
verses.pt: Então o servo correu-lhe ao encontro, e disse: Deixa-me beber, peço-te, um pouco de água do teu cântaro.
verses.en_web: The servant ran to meet her, and said, “Please give me a drink, a little water from your pitcher.”
verses.en_bbe: And the servant came running to her and said, Give me a little water from your vessel.

verses.en: And she said, Drink, my lord: and she hasted, and let down her pitcher upon her hand, and gave him drink.
verses.pt: Respondeu ela: Bebe, meu senhor. Então com presteza abaixou o seu cântaro sobre a mão e deu-lhe de beber.
verses.en_web: She said, “Drink, my lord.” She hurried, and let down her pitcher on her hand, and gave him a drink.
verses.en_bbe: And she said, Take a drink, my lord: and quickly letting down her vessel onto her hand, she gave him a drink.

verses.en: And when she had done giving him drink, she said, I will draw water for thy camels also, until they have done drinking.
verses.pt: E quando acabou de lhe dar de beber, disse: Tirarei também água para os teus camelos, até que acabem de beber.
verses.en_web: When she had finished giving him a drink, she said, “I will also draw for your camels, until they have finished drinking.”
verses.en_bbe: And having done so, she said, I will get water for your camels till they have had enough.

verses.en: And she hasted, and emptied her pitcher into the trough, and ran again unto the well to draw water, and drew for all his camels.
verses.pt: Também com presteza despejou o seu cântaro no bebedouro e, correndo outra vez ao poço, tirou água para todos os camelos dele.
verses.en_web: She hurried, and emptied her pitcher into the trough, and ran again to the well to draw, and drew for all his camels.
verses.en_bbe: And after putting the water from her vessel into the animals' drinking-place, she went quickly back to the spring and got water for all the camels.

verses.en: And the man wondering at her held his peace, to wit whether the LORD had made his journey prosperous or not.
verses.pt: E o homem a contemplava atentamente, em silêncio, para saber se o Senhor havia tornado próspera a sua jornada, ou não.
verses.en_web: The man looked steadfastly at her, remaining silent, to know whether Yahweh had made his journey prosperous or not.
verses.en_bbe: And the man, looking at her, said nothing, waiting to see if the Lord had given his journey a good outcome.

verses.en: And it came to pass, as the camels had done drinking, that the man took a golden earring of half a shekel weight, and two bracelets for her hands of ten shekels weight of gold;
verses.pt: Depois que os camelos acabaram de beber, tomou o homem um pendente de ouro, de meio siclo de peso, e duas pulseiras para as mãos dela, do peso de dez siclos de ouro;
verses.en_web: As the camels had done drinking, the man took a golden ring of half a shekel weight, and two bracelets for her hands of ten shekels weight of gold,
verses.en_bbe: And when the camels had had enough, the man took a gold nose-ring, half a shekel in weight, and two ornaments for her arms of ten shekels weight of gold;

verses.en: And said, Whose daughter art thou? tell me, I pray thee: is there room in thy father’s house for us to lodge in?
verses.pt: e perguntou: De quem és filha? dize-mo, peço-te. Há lugar em casa de teu pai para nós pousarmos?
verses.en_web: and said, “Whose daughter are you? Please tell me. Is there room in your father’s house for us to stay?”
verses.en_bbe: And said to her, Whose daughter are you? is there room in your father's house for us?

verses.en: And she said unto him, I am the daughter of Bethuel the son of Milcah, which she bare unto Nahor.
verses.pt: Ela lhe respondeu: Eu sou filha de Betuel, filho de Milca, o qual ela deu a Naor.
verses.en_web: She said to him, “I am the daughter of Bethuel the son of Milcah, whom she bore to Nahor.”
verses.en_bbe: And she said to him, I am the daughter of Bethuel, the son of Milcah, Nahor's wife.

verses.en: She said moreover unto him, We have both straw and provender enough, and room to lodge in.
verses.pt: Disse-lhe mais: Temos palha e forragem bastante, e lugar para pousar.
verses.en_web: She said moreover to him, “We have both straw and feed enough, and room to lodge in.”
verses.en_bbe: And she said, We have a great store of dry grass and cattle-food, and there is room for you.

verses.en: And the man bowed down his head, and worshipped the LORD.
verses.pt: Então inclinou-se o homem e adorou ao Senhor;
verses.en_web: The man bowed his head, and worshiped Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: And with bent head the man gave worship to the Lord;

verses.en: And he said, Blessed be the LORD God of my master Abraham, who hath not left destitute my master of his mercy and his truth: I being in the way, the LORD led me to the house of my master’s brethren.
verses.pt: e disse: Bendito seja o Senhor Deus de meu senhor Abraão, que não retirou do meu senhor a sua benevolência e a sua verdade; quanto a mim, o Senhor me guiou no caminho à casa dos irmãos de meu senhor.
verses.en_web: He said, “Blessed be Yahweh, the God of my master Abraham, who has not forsaken his loving kindness and his truth toward my master. As for me, Yahweh has led me on the way to the house of my master’s relatives.”
verses.en_bbe: And said, Praise be to the Lord, the God of my master Abraham, who has given a sign that he is good and true to my master, by guiding me straight to the house of my master's family.

verses.en: And the damsel ran, and told them of her mother’s house these things.
verses.pt: A donzela correu, e relatou estas coisas aos da casa de sua mãe.
verses.en_web: The young lady ran, and told her mother’s house about these words.
verses.en_bbe: So the girl went running and took the news of these things to her mother's house

verses.en: And Rebekah had a brother, and his name was Laban: and Laban ran out unto the man, unto the well.
verses.pt: Ora, Rebeca tinha um irmão, cujo nome era Labão, o qual saiu correndo ao encontro daquele homem até a fonte;
verses.en_web: Rebekah had a brother, and his name was Laban. Laban ran out to the man, to the spring.
verses.en_bbe: Now Rebekah had a brother named Laban, and he came out quickly to the man at the water-spring.

verses.en: And it came to pass, when he saw the earring and bracelets upon his sister’s hands, and when he heard the words of Rebekah his sister, saying, Thus spake the man unto me; that he came unto the man; and, behold, he stood by the camels at the well.
verses.pt: porquanto tinha visto o pendente, e as pulseiras sobre as mãos de sua irmã, e ouvido as palavras de sua irmã Rebeca, que dizia: Assim me falou aquele homem; e foi ter com o homem, que estava em pé junto aos camelos ao lado da fonte.
verses.en_web: When he saw the ring, and the bracelets on his sister’s hands, and when he heard the words of Rebekah his sister, saying, “This is what the man said to me,” he came to the man. Behold, he was standing by the camels at the spring.
verses.en_bbe: And when he saw the nose-ring and the ornaments on his sister's hands, and when she gave him word of what the man had said to her, then he went out to the man who was waiting with the camels by the water-spring.

verses.en: And he said, Come in, thou blessed of the LORD; wherefore standest thou without? for I have prepared the house, and room for the camels.
verses.pt: E disse: Entra, bendito do Senhor; por que estás aqui fora? pois eu já preparei a casa, e lugar para os camelos.
verses.en_web: He said, “Come in, you blessed of Yahweh. Why do you stand outside? For I have prepared the house, and room for the camels.”
verses.en_bbe: And he said to him, Come in, you on whom is the blessing of the Lord; why are you waiting outside? for I have made the house ready for you, and a place for the camels.

verses.en: And the man came into the house: and he ungirded his camels, and gave straw and provender for the camels, and water to wash his feet, and the men’s feet that were with him.
verses.pt: Então veio o homem à casa, e desarreou os camelos; deram palha e forragem para os camelos e água para lavar os pés dele e dos homens que estavam com ele.
verses.en_web: The man came into the house, and he unloaded the camels. He gave straw and feed for the camels, and water to wash his feet and the feet of the men who were with him.
verses.en_bbe: Then the man came into the house, and Laban took their cords off the camels and gave them dry grass and food, and he gave to him and the men who were with him water for washing their feet.

verses.en: And there was set meat before him to eat: but he said, I will not eat, until I have told mine errand. And he said, Speak on.
verses.pt: Depois puseram comida diante dele. Ele, porém, disse: Não comerei, até que tenha exposto a minha incumbência. Respondeu-lhe Labão: Fala.
verses.en_web: Food was set before him to eat, but he said, “I will not eat until I have told my message.” He said, “Speak on.”
verses.en_bbe: And meat was put before him, but he said, I will not take food till I have made my business clear to you. And they said, Do so.

verses.en: And he said, I am Abraham’s servant.
verses.pt: Então disse: Eu sou o servo de Abraão.
verses.en_web: He said, “I am Abraham’s servant.
verses.en_bbe: And he said, I am Abraham's servant.

verses.en: And the LORD hath blessed my master greatly; and he is become great: and he hath given him flocks, and herds, and silver, and gold, and menservants, and maidservants, and camels, and asses.
verses.pt: O Senhor tem abençoado muito ao meu senhor, o qual se tem engrandecido; deu-lhe rebanhos e gado, prata e ouro, escravos e escravas, camelos e jumentos.
verses.en_web: Yahweh has blessed my master greatly. He has become great. He has given him flocks and herds, silver and gold, male servants and female servants, and camels and donkeys.
verses.en_bbe: The Lord has given my master every blessing, and he has become great: he has given him flocks and herds and silver and gold, and men-servants and women-servants and camels and asses.

verses.en: And Sarah my master’s wife bare a son to my master when she was old: and unto him hath he given all that he hath.
verses.pt: E Sara, a mulher do meu senhor, mesmo depois, de velha deu um filho a meu senhor; e o pai lhe deu todos os seus bens.
verses.en_web: Sarah, my master’s wife, bore a son to my master when she was old. He has given all that he has to him.
verses.en_bbe: And when Sarah, my master's wife, was old, she gave birth to a son, to whom he has given all he has.

verses.en: And my master made me swear, saying, Thou shalt not take a wife to my son of the daughters of the Canaanites, in whose land I dwell:
verses.pt: Ora, o meu senhor me fez jurar, dizendo: Não tomarás mulher para meu filho das filhas dos cananeus, em cuja terra habito;
verses.en_web: My master made me swear, saying, ‘You shall not take a wife for my son from the daughters of the Canaanites, in whose land I live,
verses.en_bbe: And my master made me take an oath, saying, Do not get a wife for my son from the daughters of the Canaanites among whom I am living;

verses.en: But thou shalt go unto my father’s house, and to my kindred, and take a wife unto my son.
verses.pt: irás, porém, à casa de meu pai, e à minha parentela, e tomarás mulher para meu filho.
verses.en_web: but you shall go to my father’s house, and to my relatives, and take a wife for my son.’
verses.en_bbe: But go to my father's house and to my relations for a wife for my son.

verses.en: And I said unto my master, Peradventure the woman will not follow me.
verses.pt: Então respondi ao meu senhor: Porventura não me seguirá a mulher.
verses.en_web: I asked my master, ‘What if the woman will not follow me?’
verses.en_bbe: And I said to my master, What if the woman will not come with me?

verses.en: And he said unto me, The LORD, before whom I walk, will send his angel with thee, and prosper thy way; and thou shalt take a wife for my son of my kindred, and of my father’s house:
verses.pt: Ao que ele me disse: O Senhor, em cuja presença tenho andado, enviará o seu anjo contigo, e prosperará o teu caminho; e da minha parentela e da casa de meu pai tomarás mulher para meu filho;
verses.en_web: He said to me, ‘Yahweh, before whom I walk, will send his angel with you, and prosper your way. You shall take a wife for my son from my relatives, and of my father’s house.
verses.en_bbe: And he said, The Lord, whom I have ever kept before me, will send his angel with you, who will make it possible for you to get a wife for my son from my relations and my father's house;

verses.en: Then shalt thou be clear from this my oath, when thou comest to my kindred; and if they give not thee one, thou shalt be clear from my oath.
verses.pt: então serás livre do meu juramento, quando chegares à minha parentela; e se não ta derem, livre serás do meu juramento.
verses.en_web: Then will you be clear from my oath, when you come to my relatives. If they don’t give her to you, you shall be clear from my oath.’
verses.en_bbe: And you will be free from your oath to me when you come to my people; and if they will not give her to you, you will be free from your oath.

verses.en: And I came this day unto the well, and said, O LORD God of my master Abraham, if now thou do prosper my way which I go;
verses.pt: E hoje cheguei à fonte, e disse: Senhor, Deus de meu senhor Abraão, se é que agora prosperas o meu caminho, o qual venho seguindo,
verses.en_web: I came today to the spring, and said, ‘Yahweh, the God of my master Abraham, if now you do prosper my way which I go—
verses.en_bbe: And I came today to the water-spring, and I said, O Lord, the God of my master Abraham, if it is your purpose to give a good outcome to my journey,

verses.en: Behold, I stand by the well of water; and it shall come to pass, that when the virgin cometh forth to draw water, and I say to her, Give me, I pray thee, a little water of thy pitcher to drink;
verses.pt: eis que estou junto à fonte; faze, pois, que a donzela que sair para tirar água, a quem eu disser: Dá-me, peço-te, de beber um pouco de água do teu cântaro,
verses.en_web: behold, I am standing by this spring of water. Let it happen, that the maiden who comes out to draw, to whom I will say, “Please give me a little water from your pitcher to drink,”
verses.en_bbe: Let it come about that, while I am waiting here by the water-spring, if a girl comes to get water and I say to her, Give me a little water from your vessel, and she says,

verses.en: And she say to me, Both drink thou, and I will also draw for thy camels: let the same be the woman whom the LORD hath appointed out for my master’s son.
verses.pt: e ela me responder: Bebe tu, e também tirarei água para os teus camelos; seja a mulher que o Senhor designou para o filho de meu senhor.
verses.en_web: and she will tell me, “Drink, and I will also draw for your camels,”—let her be the woman whom Yahweh has appointed for my master’s son.’
verses.en_bbe: Take a drink, and I will get water for your camels; let her be the woman marked out by the Lord for my master's son.

verses.en: And before I had done speaking in mine heart, behold, Rebekah came forth with her pitcher on her shoulder; and she went down unto the well, and drew water: and I said unto her, Let me drink, I pray thee.
verses.pt: Ora, antes que eu acabasse de falar no meu coração, eis que Rebeca saía com o seu cântaro sobre o ombro, desceu à fonte e tirou água; e eu lhe disse: Dá-me de beber, peço-te.
verses.en_web: Before I had finished speaking in my heart, behold, Rebekah came out with her pitcher on her shoulder. She went down to the spring, and drew. I said to her, ‘Please let me drink.’
verses.en_bbe: And even while I was saying this to myself, Rebekah came out with her vessel on her arm; and she went down to the spring to get water; and I said to her, Give me a drink.

verses.en: And she made haste, and let down her pitcher from her shoulder, and said, Drink, and I will give thy camels drink also: so I drank, and she made the camels drink also.
verses.pt: E ela, com presteza, abaixou o seu cântaro do ombro, e disse: Bebe, e também darei de beber aos teus camelos; assim bebi, e ela deu também de beber aos camelos.
verses.en_web: She hurried and let down her pitcher from her shoulder, and said, ‘Drink, and I will also give your camels a drink.’ So I drank, and she also gave the camels a drink.
verses.en_bbe: And straight away she took down her vessel from her arm, and said, Take a drink, and I will get water for your camels.

verses.en: And I asked her, and said, Whose daughter art thou? And she said, The daughter of Bethuel, Nahor’s son, whom Milcah bare unto him: and I put the earring upon her face, and the bracelets upon her hands.
verses.pt: Então lhe perguntei: De quem és filha? E ela disse: Filha de Betuel, filho de Naor, que Milca lhe deu. Então eu lhe pus o pendente no nariz e as pulseiras sobre as mãos;
verses.en_web: I asked her, and said, ‘Whose daughter are you?’ She said, ‘The daughter of Bethuel, Nahor’s son, whom Milcah bore to him.’ I put the ring on her nose, and the bracelets on her hands.
verses.en_bbe: And questioning her, I said, Whose daughter are you? And she said, The daughter of Bethuel, the son of Nahor, and Milcah his wife. Then I put the ring on her nose and the ornaments on her hands.

verses.en: And I bowed down my head, and worshipped the LORD, and blessed the LORD God of my master Abraham, which had led me in the right way to take my master’s brother’s daughter unto his son.
verses.pt: e, inclinando-me, adorei e bendisse ao Senhor, Deus do meu senhor Abraão, que me havia conduzido pelo caminho direito para tomar para seu filho a filha do irmão do meu senhor.
verses.en_web: I bowed my head, and worshiped Yahweh, and blessed Yahweh, the God of my master Abraham, who had led me in the right way to take my master’s brother’s daughter for his son.
verses.en_bbe: And with bent head I gave worship and praise to the Lord, the God of my master Abraham, by whom I had been guided in the right way, to get the daughter of my master's brother for his son.

verses.en: And now if ye will deal kindly and truly with my master, tell me: and if not, tell me; that I may turn to the right hand, or to the left.
verses.pt: Agora, pois, se vós haveis de usar de benevolência e de verdade para com o meu senhor, declarai-mo; e se não, também mo declarai, para que eu vá ou para a direita ou para a esquerda.
verses.en_web: Now if you will deal kindly and truly with my master, tell me. If not, tell me, that I may turn to the right hand, or to the left.”
verses.en_bbe: And now, say if you will do what is good and right for my master or not, in order that it may be clear to me what I have to do.

verses.en: Then Laban and Bethuel answered and said, The thing proceedeth from the LORD: we cannot speak unto thee bad or good.
verses.pt: Então responderam Labão e Betuel: Do Senhor procede este negócio; nós não podemos falar-te mal ou bem.
verses.en_web: Then Laban and Bethuel answered, “The thing proceeds from Yahweh. We can’t speak to you bad or good.
verses.en_bbe: Then Laban and Bethuel said in answer, This is the Lord's doing: it is not for us to say Yes or No to you.

verses.en: Behold, Rebekah is before thee, take her, and go, and let her be thy master’s son’s wife, as the LORD hath spoken.
verses.pt: Eis que Rebeca está diante de ti, toma-a e vai-te; seja ela a mulher do filho de teu senhor, como tem dito o Senhor.
verses.en_web: Behold, Rebekah is before you. Take her, and go, and let her be your master’s son’s wife, as Yahweh has spoken.”
verses.en_bbe: See, here is Rebekah: take her and go, and let her be your master's son's wife, as the Lord has said.

verses.en: And it came to pass, that, when Abraham’s servant heard their words, he worshipped the LORD, bowing himself to the earth.
verses.pt: Quando o servo de Abraão ouviu as palavras deles, prostrou-se em terra diante do Senhor:
verses.en_web: When Abraham’s servant heard their words, he bowed himself down to the earth to Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: And at these words, Abraham's servant went down on his face and gave praise to the Lord.

verses.en: And the servant brought forth jewels of silver, and jewels of gold, and raiment, and gave them to Rebekah: he gave also to her brother and to her mother precious things.
verses.pt: e tirou o servo jóias de prata, e jóias de ouro, e vestidos, e deu-os a Rebeca; também deu coisas preciosas a seu irmão e a sua mãe.
verses.en_web: The servant brought out jewels of silver, and jewels of gold, and clothing, and gave them to Rebekah. He also gave precious things to her brother and her mother.
verses.en_bbe: Then he took jewels of silver and jewels of gold and fair robes and gave them to Rebekah: and he gave things of value to her mother and her brother.

verses.en: And they did eat and drink, he and the men that were with him, and tarried all night; and they rose up in the morning, and he said, Send me away unto my master.
verses.pt: Então comeram e beberam, ele e os homens que com ele estavam, e passaram a noite. Quando se levantaram de manhã, disse o servo: Deixai-me ir a meu senhor.
verses.en_web: They ate and drank, he and the men who were with him, and stayed all night. They rose up in the morning, and he said, “Send me away to my master.”
verses.en_bbe: Then he and the men who were with him had food and drink, and took their rest there that night; and in the morning he got up, and said, Let me now go back to my master.

verses.en: And her brother and her mother said, Let the damsel abide with us a few days, at the least ten; after that she shall go.
verses.pt: Disseram o irmão e a mãe da donzela: Fique ela conosco alguns dias, pelo menos dez dias; e depois irá.
verses.en_web: Her brother and her mother said, “Let the young lady stay with us a few days, at least ten. After that she will go.”
verses.en_bbe: But her brother and her mother said, Let the girl be with us a week or ten days, and then she may go.

verses.en: And he said unto them, Hinder me not, seeing the LORD hath prospered my way; send me away that I may go to my master.
verses.pt: Ele, porém, lhes respondeu: Não me detenhas, visto que o Senhor me tem prosperado o caminho; deixai-me partir, para que eu volte a meu senhor.
verses.en_web: He said to them, “Don’t hinder me, since Yahweh has prospered my way. Send me away that I may go to my master.”
verses.en_bbe: And he said, Do not keep me; the Lord has given a good outcome to my journey; let me now go back to my master.

verses.en: And they said, We will call the damsel, and enquire at her mouth.
verses.pt: Disseram-lhe: chamaremos a donzela, e perguntaremos a ela mesma.
verses.en_web: They said, “We will call the young lady, and ask her.”
verses.en_bbe: And they said, We will send for the girl, and let her make the decision.

verses.en: And they called Rebekah, and said unto her, Wilt thou go with this man? And she said, I will go.
verses.pt: Chamaram, pois, a Rebeca, e lhe perguntaram: Irás tu com este homem; Respondeu ela: Irei.
verses.en_web: They called Rebekah, and said to her, “Will you go with this man?” She said, “I will go.”
verses.en_bbe: And they sent for Rebekah and said to her, Are you ready to go with this man? And she said, I am ready.

verses.en: And they sent away Rebekah their sister, and her nurse, and Abraham’s servant, and his men.
verses.pt: Então despediram a Rebeca, sua irmã, e à sua ama e ao servo de Abraão e a seus homens;
verses.en_web: They sent away Rebekah, their sister, with her nurse, Abraham’s servant, and his men.
verses.en_bbe: So they sent their sister Rebekah and her servant with Abraham's servant and his men.

verses.en: And they blessed Rebekah, and said unto her, Thou art our sister, be thou the mother of thousands of millions, and let thy seed possess the gate of those which hate them.
verses.pt: e abençoaram a Rebeca, e disseram-lhe: Irmã nossa, sê tu a mãe de milhares de miríades, e possua a tua descendência a porta de seus aborrecedores!
verses.en_web: They blessed Rebekah, and said to her, “Our sister, may you be the mother of thousands of ten thousands, and let your offspring possess the gate of those who hate them.”
verses.en_bbe: And they gave Rebekah their blessing, saying, O sister, may you be the mother of thousands and ten thousands; and may your seed overcome all those who make war against them.

verses.en: And Rebekah arose, and her damsels, and they rode upon the camels, and followed the man: and the servant took Rebekah, and went his way.
verses.pt: Assim Rebeca se levantou com as suas moças e, montando nos camelos, seguiram o homem; e o servo, tomando a Rebeca, partiu.
verses.en_web: Rebekah arose with her ladies. They rode on the camels, and followed the man. The servant took Rebekah, and went his way.
verses.en_bbe: So Rebekah and her servant-women went with the man, seated on the camels; and so the servant took Rebekah and went on his way.

verses.en: And Isaac came from the way of the well Lahai-roi; for he dwelt in the south country.
verses.pt: Ora, Isaque tinha vindo do caminho de Beer-Laai-Rói; pois habitava na terra do Negebe.
verses.en_web: Isaac came from the way of Beer Lahai Roi, for he lived in the land of the South.
verses.en_bbe: Now Isaac had come through the waste land to Beer-lahai-roi; for he was living in the South.

verses.en: And Isaac went out to meditate in the field at the eventide: and he lifted up his eyes, and saw, and, behold, the camels were coming.
verses.pt: Saíra Isaque ao campo à tarde, para meditar; e levantando os olhos, viu, e eis que vinham camelos.
verses.en_web: Isaac went out to meditate in the field at the evening. He lifted up his eyes and looked. Behold, there were camels coming.
verses.en_bbe: And when the evening was near, he went wandering out into the fields, and lifting up his eyes he saw camels coming.

verses.en: And Rebekah lifted up her eyes, and when she saw Isaac, she lighted off the camel.
verses.pt: Rebeca também levantou os olhos e, vendo a Isaque, saltou do camelo
verses.en_web: Rebekah lifted up her eyes, and when she saw Isaac, she got off the camel.
verses.en_bbe: And when Rebekah, looking up, saw Isaac, she got down from her camel,

verses.en: For she had said unto the servant, What man is this that walketh in the field to meet us? And the servant had said, It is my master: therefore she took a vail, and covered herself.
verses.pt: e perguntou ao servo: Quem é aquele homem que vem pelo campo ao nosso encontro? respondeu o servo: É meu senhor. Então ela tomou o véu e se cobriu.
verses.en_web: She said to the servant, “Who is the man who is walking in the field to meet us?” The servant said, “It is my master.” She took her veil, and covered herself.
verses.en_bbe: And said to the servant, Who is that man coming to us through the field? And the servant said, It is my master: then she took her veil, covering her face with it.

verses.en: And the servant told Isaac all things that he had done.
verses.pt: Depois o servo contou a Isaque tudo o que fizera.
verses.en_web: The servant told Isaac all the things that he had done.
verses.en_bbe: Then the servant gave Isaac the story of all he had done.

verses.en: And Isaac brought her into his mother Sarah’s tent, and took Rebekah, and she became his wife; and he loved her: and Isaac was comforted after his mother’s death.
verses.pt: Isaque, pois, trouxe Rebeca para a tenda de Sara, sua mãe; tomou-a e ela lhe foi por mulher; e ele a amou. Assim Isaque foi consolado depois da morte de sua mãe.
verses.en_web: Isaac brought her into his mother Sarah’s tent, and took Rebekah, and she became his wife. He loved her. Isaac was comforted after his mother’s death.
verses.en_bbe: And Isaac took Rebekah into his tent and she became his wife; and in his love for her, Isaac was comforted after his father's death.
